title: Wakeling - Demo of my first game, a cozy incremental terraformer
author: jchr85
selftext:
Hello all,

  
[Promised to notify when I had a working version](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1y06q38/working_on_my_first_game_with_no_game_dev/) out on [itch.io](http://itch.io), and now it is :)

First time ever creating a game and I feel very happy about getting it to this point. The process has been ridiculously fun, and I hope others will find this little game fun as well.



**What's the game about?**

You’re a little larva that crash-lands on a dead planet. You eat the dead crust, and living weave grows in your trail. Roots spread from your Hearth, little creatures start working for you, and you mutate your body and grow new organs. Phase by phase you raise the air, heat and water, melt the ice into lakes, and the weave turns to moss, mushroom forest and finally jungle – until you wake the planet’s heart.

  
[The first planet is now free to play on itch](https://jchr.itch.io/wakeling) (Windows, about 60–90 minutes)

  
Since my last post I've been trying tighten the last part of the game and rebuilt most of the models in blender to get a more cohesive look.

  
I would very much appreciate some feedback if you play it, especially on what does not work or feel of, and especially towards the end. I still have a lot to learn and would like to get this to an as fun experience as possible :)
